Task:
Ordo app "depth_report": over a directed edge graph built by `link from to`, report the longest simple path (in hops = number of edges) reachable from a start node. Traversal is a depth-first search over outgoing edges in insertion order, with path-visited cycle protection (a node already on the current path is not re-entered; it is recorded as a `cycle:<node>` signal). The longest path found wins; ties keep the first one discovered in insertion-order DFS. A start node with no outgoing edge yields 0 hops and a path of just itself. The deepest path's terminal node is always reported as a `leaf:<node>` signal.

  pub struct DepthReport {
      pub start: String,        // the queried start node
      pub hops: i64,            // longest path length in edges (0 if no outgoing edge)
      pub deepest: Vec<String>, // the longest simple path as a node sequence (starts with `start`)
      pub signals: Vec<String>, // "cycle:<node>" per distinct back-edge hit (in order), then always "leaf:<terminal>"
  }
